reproductionInherited.theGap: `stripTrailingFootnoteMarker`'s regex, /(?<!\d)([.:;!?]["'’”)\]]*)\d{1,3}(\s*)$/, required the typographic-noise class it recognized to BEGIN with a literal terminal-punctuation character. A closing quote/paren/bracket was only recognized as part of that noise when it TRAILED real terminal punctuation (the already-fixed ')' + '.' order) - never when the closing bracket/quote IS the last visible character of the sentence, with no separate terminal-punctuation mark of its own, and a footnote/endnote digit glued directly onto it (a common shape: a sentence ending in a quoted defined term or a parenthetical qualifier, either by drafting convention or because plain-text PDF extraction lost/merged a period colliding with an adjacent superscript glyph).

reproductionInherited.secondaryFinding: FALSIFICATION-2 (secondary, data-quality not rank-stack): when ARTICLE_PATTERNS[0]'s ALL-CAPS title-shape requirement failed to match a genuinely lowercase-titled heading (reachable at all only because ciKeyword made the keyword case-insensitive), bestMatches fell back to ARTICLE_PATTERNS[1] (the crude line-anchored pattern), which has no title-shape validation or noise-stripping at all and captured the entire rest of the physical line - including a glued footnote digit and trailing parenthetical - verbatim as the heading text.

explicitNonGoal: Per this phase's own instruction and the auditor's own report ('generalizes to closing quotes and to SECTION-level headings too'), the fix does NOT special-case 'digit glued to a closing paren/quote' as one more enumerated shape - that would only produce the next unseen shape's future gap. The fix generalizes the underlying noise CLASS and moves acceptance to a SCORED, compositional evaluation of independent signals, per this phase's own §9-10 requirement, so no single exact typographic feature is ever a mandatory gate.

mechanisms.name: stripTrailingFootnoteMarker - generalized noise CLASS
mechanisms.whatChanged: The regex-anchored-on-leading-punctuation implementation is replaced with an explicit function: a short (1-3 digit) run, not itself preceded by another digit (so it can never split a real multi-digit number), glued with NO intervening whitespace onto whatever character actually precedes it - punctuation, a closing bracket/quote, or anything else - is recognized as footnote/endnote-marker noise, UNLESS stripping it would unmask the fractional part of a real decimal number (the character immediately before the digit run is '.', itself immediately preceded by a digit - e.g. '4.00', the exact Category-6 precision case the original `(?<!\d)` lookbehind protected, re-expressed for a class no longer anchored to one leading punctuation character). A digit run preceded by real WHITESPACE is deliberately excluded and left entirely to the pre-existing, unmodified `stripTrailingPageNumberArtifact` - keeping the two noise classes (glued vs. whitespace-bounded) structurally disjoint, exactly as the pre-existing doc-comment already required.
mechanisms.whyThisIsGeneral: The class is now defined by SHAPE (a short digit run glued with zero whitespace to anything, guarded only against splitting a real decimal number), not by an enumerated list of which specific characters may precede it. It composes safely with every character it can be glued to - a period, a colon, a closing paren, a closing quote, a closing bracket, an ordinary letter - with no per-character special case anywhere in the implementation.

mechanisms.name: isPlausibleByPositionalSignals - SCORED, compositional evaluation replacing the strict boolean OR gate
mechanisms.whatChanged: The old gate accepted a candidate only if signal (A) 2+ newlines OR signal (B) trailing terminal punctuation held (each independently a hard, all-or-nothing typographic requirement). The new gate (`PLAUSIBILITY_SIGNAL_WEIGHT` / `PLAUSIBILITY_SCORE_THRESHOLD`) computes a weighted score from FIVE independent signals and accepts once the combined weight clears a fixed threshold (3): PARAGRAPH_BREAK (weight 3, independently sufficient, unchanged), SENTENCE_TERMINAL_PUNCTUATION (weight 3, independently sufficient, unchanged), NOISE_DISCOUNTED (weight 1, alone insufficient - a real typographic noise artifact was actually present at the boundary and had to be discounted to see through to it), CLOSING_DELIMITER (weight 1, alone insufficient - the text, once noise is discounted, ends in a closing quotation mark or bracket), and AT_LEAST_ONE_NEWLINE (weight 1, alone insufficient - the candidate is at least on its own line).
mechanisms.whyThisClosesOPEN1: NOISE_DISCOUNTED + CLOSING_DELIMITER + AT_LEAST_ONE_NEWLINE (1+1+1=3) together clear the threshold for the falsifying shape (a footnote digit glued to a bare closing bracket/quote, single newline, no other punctuation) - three independent pieces of real corroborating evidence (something was glued on and had to be discounted; the real underlying character is a just-closed delimiter; the candidate is genuinely on its own line) together, never one exact feature alone.
mechanisms.whyCLOSING_DELIMITERisNeverStandaloneSuf: A dedicated negative-control test (`part-b-recert-finding1-independent.test.ts` describe block 9) proves that CLOSING_DELIMITER + AT_LEAST_ONE_NEWLINE alone (weight 2, no noise discounted) does NOT clear the threshold - an ordinary in-text citation ending in a parenthetical qualifier, sitting on its own line, must not be laundered into a heading merely because it ends in a closing bracket. Requiring NOISE_DISCOUNTED as well anchors acceptance to the same narrow 'footnote/page-marker context' signal this whole remediation is about, not a bare bracket shape by itself.
mechanisms.signalsDeliberatelyExcluded: Numbering-rank-sequence continuity and citation-context (lexical) signals - both named as available in principle by this phase's own charter - are deliberately NOT included as acceptance-granting weight. Both were already concretely shown, in this same file's own prior remediation record (the defect-3/Category-6 multi-column-collapse analysis, re-proven in tests/certification/part-b-recert-blocker1-independent-adversarial.test.ts describe block 3), to be indistinguishable by any positional or numbering evidence available to this design from a real, certified false-positive shape (a table row/bullet-list/signature-block fragment immediately followed by the numerically next section, one newline, no terminal punctuation). Adding rank continuity as sufficient weight - or even as one more point tipping a bare single newline over threshold - would silently reopen that already-examined, certified boundary. Left out on the same honest, evidence-based basis the phase's own prior work used, not by oversight; documented explicitly rather than silently omitted.

mechanisms.name: extractTitleLikeSpan - fixes FALSIFICATION-2 (secondary) by reusing, not duplicating, the existing title-shape principle
mechanisms.whatChanged: ARTICLE heading text (from whichever pattern produced the match) is now trimmed to its own leading run of `[A-Za-z ,&';-]` characters - the SAME character set ARTICLE_PATTERNS[0]'s own ALL-CAPS title-shape regex already restricts a real title to (minus case-sensitivity, for the identical reason `ciKeyword` is case-insensitive: an author's/OCR engine's capitalization convention is typographic noise, the character composition of the title is genuine shape evidence). This is a complete no-op for ARTICLE_PATTERNS[0]'s own shape-based match (whose title already contains nothing outside this class by construction of its own regex) and is the general fix for ARTICLE_PATTERNS[1]'s crude line-anchored fallback, which previously had no title-shape validation of its own at all.
mechanisms.whyThisIsGeneral: Applied uniformly to every ARTICLE heading regardless of which pattern produced it - never a fallback-specific special case - and reuses an existing, already-load-bearing character class rather than inventing a new one.

selfAssessmentAgainstSection10Invariant.invariant: No plausible heading should disappear merely from the conjunction of lowercase keyword + one newline + footnote-adjacency + missing blank lines (this phase's own §10 structural invariant), and no single typographic feature (case, exact punctuation before a footnote digit) should be a hard gate when other strong evidence already establishes a heading.
selfAssessmentAgainstSection10Invariant.honestAssessment: The fix satisfies this invariant for every case constructed against it, including the explicit worst-case stacked test (describe block 12: lowercase keyword + single newline + footnote digit glued to a closing quote + zero blank lines anywhere, all four at once) and the property-based fuzz suite's 1500 randomly-composed documents. It does NOT, however, make heading recognition unconditionally noise-proof in every conceivable shape: a footnote/endnote digit glued to a PLAIN WORD with no punctuation and no bracket/quote at all (e.g. '...Corporation1\n'), combined with only a single newline and no other evidence, still scores below threshold and is still rejected - deliberately, because that shape is typographically indistinguishable (by any signal this design can observe) from the already-certified Category-6/multi-column-collapse false-positive boundary (a table row, bullet-list item, or signature block followed by the numerically next real section, one newline, no terminal punctuation). Recovering that residual shape would require either a numbering-rank-sequence or lexical-citation signal, both of which were deliberately excluded above with concrete counter-evidence that doing so reopens a real, existing, certified false-positive regression. This is disclosed here as a known, bounded, evidence-backed limitation - not claimed as unconditionally fixed - consistent with this phase's own preference for an honest boundary over a claim that a subsequent audit would falsify.
selfAssessmentAgainstSection10Invariant.compositionalityAssessment: The design is genuinely scored/compositional in the sense required: three of five signals (NOISE_DISCOUNTED, CLOSING_DELIMITER, AT_LEAST_ONE_NEWLINE) are each individually insufficient and only accept in combination, verified directly by the dedicated negative-control tests (describe block 9) showing that removing any one of the three drops the combined case below threshold. The two strongest signals (PARAGRAPH_BREAK, SENTENCE_TERMINAL_PUNCTUATION) remain independently sufficient by design, unchanged from the original architecture, because they were never the source of OPEN-1's gap and weakening them was never required or attempted.

overallSummary: OPEN-1 (BLOCKER-1, structural heading false negatives / rank-stack corruption): root-cause fixed in lib/contract-model/compiler/stage-structure.ts. stripTrailingFootnoteMarker's noise CLASS is generalized from 'begins with literal terminal punctuation' to 'a short digit run glued to any preceding character, guarded against splitting a real decimal number'. The strict signal-A-OR-signal-B boolean plausibility gate is replaced with a SCORED, compositional evaluation of five independent signals, three of which are individually weak and only accept together - never one exact typographic feature treated as a hard, mandatory gate. A secondary heading-text data-quality regression (FALSIFICATION-2) is fixed by reusing the existing title-shape character class, case-insensitively, uniformly across every ARTICLE-producing pattern. All 4 originally red-pinned Part B assertions now pass unmodified; 14 fresh tests covering every category this phase's own §20 STRUCTURE list requires were added; 204 tests across the full structural-heading regression surface (including a 1500-document property-based fuzz suite) pass with zero regressions; the wider contract-model test failures present in this session are independently confirmed, via git-stash reversion, to pre-exist this fix entirely (a concurrent sibling workstream's in-progress semantic-verification work sharing this container). tsc and eslint show zero new errors beyond the measured pre-existing baseline.
